"Recently updated" works — the arXiv note shows near the top from its recent edit, and editing the oldest bookmark's note jumps it to the top. Refresh **http://maker:4001**.

**Flow 10 (extended) — Recently updated.** Open **Sort** and choose **Recently updated**:
1. The **arXiv** bookmark rises near the top, because it was edited recently even though it was saved long ago.
2. **Edit** any older bookmark — change its note and save — then it jumps to the top of **Recently updated**. Marking read, archiving, or changing tags counts as an update too.

Confirm the sort set now matches what you'd use: **date added (newest/oldest)**, **recently updated**, **title (A–Z / Z–A)** — and that "recently updated" reflecting *any* change to a bookmark (edits, notes, tags, read/archive) is what you'd expect. If so, sorting is settled and I'll move to **bulk actions** on selected bookmarks next.
